info.title: Meridian API
info.description: Multi-tenant work and knowledge API. The tenant is always resolved from the session, never from the request.

201.description: Created; the signing secret is shown once

400.description: Invalid URL (must be public https) or filters

200.description: The new secret, shown once; the old one stops working

404.description: Entity not found or not visible

201.description: Stored; scanning continues in the background

400.description: Bad field, file type not allowed, or empty file

403.description: Only the uploader or a project admin can delete

204.description: Password changed; every other sign-in ended

400.description: Current password wrong, or new password too weak/unchanged

202.description: If the address belongs to an account, a reset email is on its way

200.description: MFA status of the signed-in user
MFA enabled; the recovery codes are shown once

400.description: Wrong code or nothing to confirm
Wrong password or code, or a workspace requires MFA

200.description: A fresh authenticator secret (not active until confirmed)
A new set of recovery codes (the old ones stop working)

400.description: Wrong code or MFA not enabled

401.description: Challenge expired/used up or code wrong
Refresh token invalid, expired or reused

400.description: Invalid or expired token, or weak password

303.description: Session cookies set and redirect to the app (or ?sso_error=)
Redirect to the identity provider (or back to the app with ?sso_error=)

200.description: Plan, usage against limits and available actions

400.description: Billing not configured or unknown plan

204.description: Plan switched (development builds without Stripe only)

400.description: Unknown plan or usage exceeds the target plan

200.description: Success. The ETag header is the If-Match value for edits

parameters.description: Optional ETag from the issue details. If the issue changed since, the edit is refused with 412 and nothing is written

412.description: The issue changed since the If-Match ETag was issued

200.description: Every kind with its current setting; enabled by default

404.description: Page not found or not visible

404.description: Project not found or not visible

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size, 1 to 500 (default 500, the size clients received before paging existed).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Continue below the issue number returned in `X-Next-Cursor`.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Exact status key, as defined by the project's workflow.

parameters.name: priority
parameters.description: Exact priority filter: low, medium, high or urgent.

parameters.name: assignee_id
parameters.description: Only issues assigned to this user.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive title search, up to 200 characters.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: `true` lists archived issues instead of active ones (default `false`).

200.description: Success. X-Next-Cursor is present when another page exists

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional client key (8 to 255 visible ASCII characters). A retry with the same key and body replays the original 201 response with Idempotent-Replayed: true; the same key with a different body returns 409

409.description: Idempotency-Key reused for a different request

200.description: Batch applied; per-item results name any skipped issues
The project's statuses in column order

201.description: Created at the end of the board

409.description: Issues still use it, or it is the last To do status
A project needs at least one To do status

200.description: Your saved views for this project

409.description: A view with this name already exists

200.description: Your active sign-ins in this workspace

404.description: No such active session of yours

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Resume after this sync_id (Last-Event-ID header also works)

429.description: Too many open streams for this user

400.description: Enable MFA on your own account first

200.description: SSO configuration and verified domains (never the client secret)

400.description: Invalid settings or provider discovery failed

Approval.description: An approval request. Columns match the `approvals` table.

challenge.description: Send this with the code to `/auth/mfa/verify`.

mfa_required.description: Present (true) when the password was right but a second factor is still needed.

token.description: Empty in cookie mode (the session lives in an HttpOnly cookie).

BulkIssueInput.description:
Batch change for issues in one project. Each item is checked and reported; the whole batch
commits or rolls back together.

ids.description: Issue ids in this project: 1 to 100 values; duplicates are ignored.

value.description: The new status or priority, or a user id for `set_assignee`. Null clears the assignee.

error.description: Why the issue was skipped; null when it was updated.

IssueDetail.description: Every column of an issue. Clients receive the same fields as before, now with a fixed schema.

name.description: 1 to 80 characters; unique per member and project.

key.description: Optional. Derived from the name when absent: lowercase letters, digits and underscores.

Notification.description: One inbox entry. Columns match the `notifications` table.

governed_by.description: The nearest restricted ancestor whose grants apply (or the page itself).

your_level.description: Your effective level on the page: 1 viewer, 2 editor, 3 admin.

visibility.description: `workspace` (everyone in the workspace) or `private` (explicit grants only).

refresh_token.description: API clients send the refresh token here; browsers rely on the HttpOnly cookie.

filters.description: Any of `status`, `priority`, `assignee_id` and `q`, with the same rules as the issue list.

client_secret.description: Required the first time; omit to keep the stored secret.

position.description: New column index. Other statuses shift to make room.

events.description: Event filters such as `issue.created`, `page.*` or `*`. Empty means every event.
